from pathlib import Path
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Full-width and full-height uniform lines are the panel dividers.
    row_div = {r: grid[r][0] for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1}
    col_div = {c: grid[0][c] for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1}
    divider_candidates = list(row_div.values()) + list(col_div.values())
    divider = max(set(divider_candidates), key=divider_candidates.count)
    row_lines = [r for r, v in row_div.items() if v == divider]
    col_lines = [c for c, v in col_div.items() if v == divider]
    def segments(n, lines):
        out=[]; start=0
        for x in sorted(lines):
            if x > start: out.append((start,x))
            start=x+1
        if start<n: out.append((start,n))
        return out
    row_segs=segments(h,row_lines); col_segs=segments(w,col_lines)
    # The most common non-divider color is the panel background.
    counts={}
    for row in grid:
        for v in row:
            if v != divider: counts[v]=counts.get(v,0)+1
    background=max(counts,key=counts.get)
    result=[]
    for r0,r1 in row_segs:
        outrow=[]
        for c0,c1 in col_segs:
            marks=sum(grid[r][c] != background and grid[r][c] != divider
                      for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1))
            outrow.append(1 if marks == 2 else background)
        result.append(outrow)
    return result
'''
